How we set the lines

  • Exact model first. Look-alike names and older models are the commonest way to overpay, so every entry names the model to buy and the ones it is confused with.
  • Good is a price we would pay ourselves today; Great is as low as we have seen it at a major US store or the maker's own store, with the date.
  • Sources: list prices from the maker, and prices seen at Walmart, Target, Best Buy, Home Depot, Costco, Chewy, PetSmart and brand stores, each named with its date in the card. We never quote prices, ratings or price history from Amazon; the button opens the product page, which shows today's price and has its own price-history link.
  • Verdicts: Buy now when the usual price is already near the low or you need it before a date (a holiday, winter); Fair price when sales move it only a little; Wait for a sale when a dated record shows a bigger cut is likely soon. We change a verdict only after re-checking, and the date on each card says when.
  • We earn a commission on Amazon purchases through the buttons; it never changes the lines. How we rank · Disclosure
